interpretation: The RM23 temporal endpoint difference is detectable in the next-window fixed-interface q_swap(H) response.
The response difference is nearly a constant vertical offset over the preregistered F-GC44 head bracket; response slopes are very similar.
Therefore the two temporal endpoints are not functionally identical at the admitted F-GC44 nonlinear residual resolution.

The F-GC44 1e-15 m/s residual is a coupling-solve closure criterion, not yet an independent application temporal-accuracy requirement; RM27 must not convert this falsification into an application rejection by itself.
The absolute response difference is small relative to the physical groundwater flux, so its integrated and coupled-endpoint effect must be quantified separately.
nonclaims: RM27 does not establish that the response difference is hydrologically material.
RM27 does not define a replacement temporal tolerance.
RM27 does not admit or reject the three-model triangle at application level.
next_required_boundary: Quantify the induced same-window groundwater-transfer difference and the shift in the coupled SWAP-MODFLOW fixed-interface endpoint using the already admitted F-GC44 one-cell groundwater response. Keep this as effect-size characterization, not threshold calibration.
